'''Tick''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. They were part of a group that were stranded on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] in [[4 BBY]] following an [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|attack on the brigade]]. 

==Biography==
By [[4 BBY]], Tick had joined the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] to fight against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], the brigade was [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|attacked]] and Tick was apart of a group of at least sixteen members of the brigade that survived the attack and escaped aboard a [[starship]] that landed on [[Yavin 4]]. However [[Bardi's brother|one member]] of the group subsequently departed in the ship leaving Tick and the rest of the group stranded on the [[moon]]. The brigade members later encountered an individual named [[Porko]] that they found near a clearing with a damaged [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]]. A conflict arose which resulted in the [[death]] of Porko.<ref name="One Year Later" />

Two [[Standard day|days]] after being stranded on the moon [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], an associate of Porko, landed near the group in a [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stolen]] [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]]. As Andor approached the HOY-39 he called out for Porko only to have the Maya Pei group announced their presence and take Andor prisoner. Tick held a [[blaster]] to Andor's back as two members of the group [[Gerdis]] and [[Bardi]] took turns trying to interrogate Andor. However the interrogation was interrupted when [[Rika]], another member of the group, found the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[pilot]] [[helmet]] in the TIE and proclaimed that Andor was an imperial test pilot.<ref name="One Year Later" /> 

That night, an argument between the group erupted when discussing who should be in charge ultimately coming to a head when [[Crab]] shot Rika with his [[blaster]] and [[Rowd]] responded by shooting Crab. The brigade members exchange fire between each other while splitting into two factions; with Tick siding with Bardi, [[Musk]], Rowd, [[Nazy]], [[Neek]] and [[Flu (individual)|Flu]] and regrouping at the TIE while the other group retreated to the crashed HOY-39.<ref name="One Year Later" /> After it began to rain later that night, Tick watched from the TIE as Nazy crawled through the rain towards where Rika was shot to check if she was still alive. At the same time Snee, member of the other faction, was crawling through the rain looking for Crab's body. As Nazy proclaimed that he could not find Rika's body, Snee found a part of Crab's [[limb|leg]]. Freaking out, Snee ran back towards the HOY-39 while firing at the TIE group. When Nazy made it back to the TIE group he told them that he could only find Rika's [[goggles]].<ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref>

The following morning the [[Rowd]] a member of the group cut open a fowl smelling [[Yavin 4 melon]]. When Bardi tossed a piece of the fruit to Flu, Tick told him to eat it. Asking why they should eat it Flu instead tossed it to Tick who passed it over to Neek. The group talked a bit before Bardi eventually mustered up the courage to take a bite of the melon. Later in day the group began trying to use rope to rotate the TIE so that its weapons would point towards the other group. Tick noting the slow progress asked Bardi if he realized how long it could take to aim the TIE before the group continued its efforts. When other group found out about the attempt to rotate the TIE they opened fire at it, forcing Tick's group to suspend their attempts. That night Gerdis decided to issue a challenge to Bardi to settle the dispute. The two groups cross towards each other before all dropping their weapons in unison. Tick watched the two leaders engage in a game of [[Five Hands]] with [[Roski rules]]. During the game, Andor took the opportunity to make his escape. While Andor was making his way to the TIE, a [[Yavinian doodar]] came out of the [[jungle]] and scooped Bardi and Gerdis in it's mouth. The rest of the group, including Tick scrambled for their guns and began to shoot wildly into the jungle. By the time the group realized that Andor had made it to the TIE and was taking off it was too late to stop him from leaving. Which left the group stranded yet again..<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />

==Personality and traits==
Tick had tan skin, [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s and brown [[hair]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Equipment==
While stranded on Yavin 4 Tick carried a [[blaster pistol]] and wore a yellow [[jacket]], over a brown shirt and brown [[clothing|pants]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gerdis-Tick-Bardi-MichaelWilkinson-Instagram.png|thumb|right|300px|Bardi, Gerdis, and Tick stand posed in their rugged rebel costumes.|Michael Wilkinson worked on Tick and the rest of the Maya Pei Brigade's costumes.]]
Tick was portrayed by [[Samiah Khan]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's first and second episodes, "[[One Year Later]]" and "[[Sagrona Teema]]," which were both released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>

Costume designer [[Michael Wilkinson]] and concept artist [[Glyn Dillon]] worked on the costumes for the Maya Pei Brigade, treating them as threadbare survivalists who needed to contrast from the luxury refinement of costumes on [[Chandrila]], the sophistication of costumes on [[Coruscant]], and the agricultural workwear of [[Mina-Rau]], all other settings on the show.<ref name="Costumes">{{Instagram|username=michaelwilkinson|url=p/DLVGZ5Ox7tE|name=[[Michael Wilkinson]]|date=2025-06-25|quote=For the threadbare survivalists of the #MayaPei gang, the costumes we created needed to seem far from the luxury and refinement of #Chandrila, the urbane sophistication of #Coruscant, and the agricultural workwear of #MinaRau. Illustrations by @glyn_dillon  #costumedesign #starwars #andor #andorofficial #fashion #cdg892 #fyc costumes|archiveurl=https://archive.is/IGILm|archivefile=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image1-Instagram.png|archivefile2=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image2-Instagram.png|archivefile3=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image3-Instagram.png|archivefile4=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image4-Instagram.png|archivefile5=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image5-Instagram.png|archivefile6=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image6-Instagram.png|archivefile7=File:MichaelWilkinson-MayaPeiBrigade-Image7-Instagram.png}}</ref>
